syādetat | prathamādhyāye pramāṇādayaḥ padārthā uddiṣṭāḥ | yathoddeśaṃ ca sajātīya-
vyāvṛttyā lakṣaṇato'dhigatāḥ | tat kimaparamavaśiṣyate yadarthaṃ dvitīyādyadhyāyatrayamārabhyata
ityata āha vārtikakāraḥ trividhetyādi1 | ayamarthaḥ, yadyapi prathamādhyāye uddeśalakṣaṇe
kṛte tathāpyābhāsavyāvṛttalakṣaṇatvavyavasthāpanaṃ kriyate iti ||

saṃśayaparīkṣākramavyatikramahetumasahamānaḥ pratyavatiṣṭhate--tatretyādi kramabheda2 ityantena
iti parihāraṃ manyante | bhāṣyakārā iti śeṣaḥ | arthāntaratvānivṛtteriti vārttikaṃ
prakṛtapūrvapakṣānācchādakam | tataśca saṃbandha[2 ka]sya niyāmakatvānupapatteriti sūcanamaparaḥ[?] |
tathā hi dharmadharmibhāvasya niyāmakatvamuktam | tacca saṃbandhasadbhāvāditi pūrvapakṣiṇaḥ
abhiprāyaḥ | sa ca saṃbandho rūparasayorapi śakyo darśayitum, tatrāpyekārthasamavāyasya
vidyamānatvāt | tataśca rūpe dṛṣṭe rase'pi saṃśayaḥ syāditi boddhavyam3 ||

vipratipattiśabdasyeti | vipratipattiśabdābhilapyasyārthasyeti bodhyavyaṃ na tu
yathāśrutam, yato na śabdasya nāmāntarakaraṇaṃ saṃbhavatīti ||

sā [ca] vimṛśyeyādibhāṣyavyākhyānaparavārttikasya pūrvapakṣācchādakatvamupapādayituṃ
bhūmimāracayati ṭīkākāraḥ uddeśakramānurodhena taditi | nanu coddeśa[2 kha]krama
eva kathaṃ lakṣaṇe yāvatā lakṣaṇe'pi saṃśayasya pūrvabhāvitvāt tatrāpi saṃśayasyaiva prathamaṃ
lakṣaṇaṃ kartumucitam | tat kathaṃ pramāṇasya lakṣaṇamapi pūrvaṃ setsyatītyata āha--na
khalviti | ayamarthaḥ, lakṣaṇe saṃśayaḥ pūrvabhāvyeva paraṃ na tvavayavabhūtaḥ | parīkṣāyāmava-
yavabhūtaśca saṃśaya ityetāvatā parīkṣāparvaṇi saṃśayasya prathamabhāvaḥ | atraiva prakṛtānurūpaṃ
dṛṣṭāntamupadarśayati yathetyādinā | nanu ca saṃśayaparīkṣā saṃśayapūrvikā na vā ? yadi na
tadā sā [ca] vimṛśyetyādibhāṣyabhaṅgaḥ | atha saṃśayapūrvikā, tadāpi kiṃ parīkṣita[3 ka]-
saṃśayapūrvikā na vā ? yadi na, tadā aparīkṣita eva saṃśayaḥ pramāṇaparīkṣāheturbhaviṣyati,

alaṃ saṃśayaparīkṣayā | tathā coddeśakrama evāstu | atha parīkṣitasaṃśayapūrvikā ? tadā
tatpūrvatatpūrvabhāvisaṃśayaparīkṣāyāmanavasthetyata āha--saṃśayalakṣaṇaṃ cātreti | nanvevamapi
lakṣaṇaparīkṣā tatpūrvabhāvīparīkṣitasaṃśayavyaktipūrvikā na vā ? yadi na, tadā yathoktadoṣa-
prasaraḥ | atha parīkṣitasaṃśayavyaktipūrvikā, tatrāpi sā pūrvabhāvinī vyaktiḥ kiṃ lakṣaṇa-
parīkṣayā 1parīkṣitā, utānyathā ? yadyanyathā, sā gatiḥ prakṛte'pyastu | alaṃ saṃśaya-
parīkṣayā | na ca [3 kha] sā saṃbhavatyapi | atha lakṣaṇaparīkṣayā, tathā satyaparīkṣitaiva,
lakṣaṇasyedānīṃ parīkṣyamāṇatvāt ||

parīkṣitapūrvabhāvisaṃśayavyaktikā na vetyevamākāro vikalpaḥ ṭīkākṛtaiva nirasto
yadevamāha--saṃśayalakṣaṇaṃ cātreti | atha lakṣaṇadvāreṇa vā bhavatvanyathā vā parīkṣitāsau
saṃśayavyaktirna veti yujyata eva vikalpaḥ, tadāpyucyate--aparikṣitaiva sā lakṣaṇapūrvabhāvinī
vyaktirna ca yathoktadoṣaḥ, saṃśaye parīkṣāyāḥ pramāṇaparīkṣāṃ pratyupayogitvāt | tathā hi
yadā pareṇa kāraṇākṣepadvāreṇa saṃśaya eva pratikṣipto bhavet, saṃśayamūlā ca pramāṇādi-
parīkṣāpi tadā [4 ka] anākṣiptasaṃśayapramāṇādiparīkṣā setsyatīti saṃśayasyopayogo'stīti-
etāvatā saṃśayaparīkṣā pramāṇādiparīkṣāyāḥ pūrvamuktā | saṃśayaparīkṣāyāṃ tu pūrvabhāvivyakti-
mātreṇaivopayoga iti na kācidarthakṣatiriti | 2vādiprativādinoriti guruśiṣyayoḥ |
nanu śiṣyamāṇatvaṃ kathaṃ gurau, tasya nirṇītaśāstrārtha[ka]tvāt ? satyam, āhatasaṃśayena
tasyāpi vicārakatvāt śiṣyamāṇasyeva śiṣyamāṇatvamiti | na ca yathāśruto'rthaḥ |
3tasmādasti śāstre'pītyuttaragranthavirodhāt | śāstre hi vādiprativādibhāvābhāvāditi
pūrvamapi na kuryāditi | ityasaṃśaya iti śeṣaḥ ||

4yatpunarityādi bhā[4 kha]ṣyavyākhyānaparaṃ vārttikaṃ pūrayitvā paṭhati--5yadapi
etaditi | tadativyāpakamiti | akāryakāraṇabhūtayorapi savyetaraviṣāṇayorutpatterbhāvādi-
tyarthaḥ | avyāptimān | nityānāmapīti | nityānāmapyākāśādināmutpattyabhāve'pi
kāraṇatvāditi bhāvaḥ ||

6nanu ca saṃśayākṣepahetubhiḥ saṃśayo'pi pratikṣipyata eva vijigīṣukathāyām, tat
kathaṃ svayaṃ na pratiṣeddhavya ityata āha--paricikṣiṣamāṇeneti | vādalakṣaṇāyāmiti
na yuktam, na hi vāda eva paraṃ parīkṣā, jalpavitaṇḍayorapi puruṣaśaktiparīkṣālakṣaṇayoḥ
bhāvāt | satyam, prakṛtaparīkṣāyāmidam | tathā hi pramāṇādiparīkṣā vāda[5 kha]kathayaiva
parīkṣitaḥ iti mā

vā || 1vyudasya saṃśayamiti | atra vyudasyeti ktvāpratyaya āsyaṃ vyādāya
svapītivad draṣṭavyaḥ || 8 ||

2na pramāṇanimitteti | yadi paścāt pramāṇaṃ sidhyati, tarhi na pramāṇanimittā
prameyasaṃjñā syāditi | evaṃ ca sati pramāṇanimittā prameyasaṃjñeti vyādhātaḥ | atra pakṣe
pramāṇanimittā prameyasaṃjñeti kākākṣavad yojyam | pramāṇanimittā prameyasaṃjñeti pāṭhapakṣe tu
vyaktameva vārttikam || 10 ||

3indriyārthānāmiti | indriyā[5 kha]rthānāṃ sannipāte buddhināṃ yugapadbhāva iti
yojanā | atha vā budhyate'neneti vyutpattyā indriyāṇāmiti bodhaḥ | atra cakāro'rthavān ||

dharmapratiṣedhācceti | atra vikalpya dūṣaṇamunneyam | tathā hi kiṃ prāmāṇyalakṣaṇa-
dharmasya pratyakṣādibhyo'rthāntaratvamupeyate na vā ? yadāpyarthāntaratvaṃ tadāpi kiṃ saṃyogādivaddharma,
āho sāmānyavaditi ? tadyadi prathamaḥ, tatrāha--dharmapratiṣedhācceti | atha svābhāvikaḥ
sāmānyādirūpastatrāpi tamevāśaṅkyāha--atha bhāvasyeti | bhāvasya svabhāvasya sāmānya-
viśeṣasya niṣedhe'svatantratvāt | tānyapi sāmānyaviśeṣavanti pramāṇāni | pratisiddhānīti
anivṛtto'nuyogo vyāghātaśce[6 ka]ti | atraivaṃ vyāghāto boddhavyaḥ | prāmāṇyavyatiriktaṃ
pramāṇamabhyanujñāyamānaṃ pramāṇenaivābhyanujñeyaṃ pramāṇaprāmāṇyaṃ ca pratikṣipyata iti ||

saṃprati pūrvavikalpitamanarthāntaratvapakṣamurīkṛtvāha--arthāntarānabhyupagame ceti |
anivṛtto vyāghāta iti | atrānuyogo vyāghātaśceti dvayaṃ yojyam | tathā hi pratyakṣā-
dīnāṃ pṛthaksvarūpaṃ vācyamityanuyogaḥ | taccābhidhīyamānaṃ pramāṇenaiveti tatpratipādakapramāṇena
vyāghāta ityarthaḥ ||
4anabhyanu[6 kha]jñāne ceti bhāṣyatātparyamāha--virodho doṣa iti ||

vikalpānantaraṃ hi vikalpapraśno yukta iti vārttikakāro vikalpānantaraṃ praśnaṃ
yojayati--kiṃ cāta iti | bhāṣyakārastvasthāne niyuktavāniti bodho vārtikakārasyeti ||

vyāghātāditi grahaṇakavākyaṃ vivṛṇoti--saṃbhavo nivartyata itīti | pratiṣedhā-
rthāparijñānāditi grahaṇakavākyaṃ vivṛṇoti--na ceti | jñāpakatvācceti | etacca

bodhyavyam | pratiṣedhārthāparijñānāccetyanena pūrvapakṣiṇo vipratipattirnigrahasthānamuktam |
jñāpakatvācca ityanena cāpratipattirityudbhāvanabhedamabhipretyāpaunaruktyamiti bodhyavyam ||

1yat khalu triṣvapi kāleṣvasādhakamiti, atrāsādhakamityasyāsiddhamityayamarthaḥ
avidyamānaṃ sādhakaṃ yasya tadasādhakamiti vyutpattyā bodhyavyaḥ | na pratyakṣādīni prati-
ṣiddhānīti | idaṃ khalu vārttikaṃ dharmapratiṣedhācca pratyakṣādyabhyupagama ityanena
punaruktameva | tataścaivamidaṃ bodhyavyam | pūrvaṃ vikalpya dūṣaṇaṃ nābhihitamidānīṃ tu tathocyate |
[7 kha] adhikamatra vaktuṃ vikalya iti | na ca dharmiṇāmityādi cātrādhikamitya-
paunaruktyam |

saṃjñābhedamātramiti | pramāṇādbhinnasyābhinnārthābodhakatvānupapatteriti bhāvaḥ | na
pratyakṣādīnāmabhāvamiti | atyantābhāvamityarthaḥ | na ghaṭābhāvamiti | na ghaṭasyātyantā-
bhāvamityarthaḥ | evamanenāpīti | aneneti nāstinetyarthaḥ | anena pratiṣidhyanta
iti | aneneti nāstineti || 12 ||

3upādīyate na vetyetadvārttikānantaraṃ vikalpadvayaṃ draṣṭavyam | upādānapakṣe'pi
pratyakṣādīnāṃ prāmāṇyamupeyate na vā ? yadyupādīyate, pratyakṣādiprāmāṇyaṃ cābhyupeyate tatrāha--
yadyupādīyata iti | [8 ka] atha nābhyupeyate, tatrāha--pratyakṣādīnāṃ ceti | yaśca
pramāṇaṃ nābhyupaiti tasya sakalalaukikaparīkṣakasiddhavyāhāravyavahāravirodha ityāha--buddhi-
vivakṣeti || 13 ||

4iti sūtramiti | ekaiva dvidhā vyaktā, sūtre'tra tu dvidhā dvayamastīti | sūcanāt
sūtramityuktam | vārttikakāra ākṣepasthāne ākṣepaṃ bhāṣyasthamudāharati--kasmāt
punariti | idānīmaparamapyapekṣitaṃ bhāṣyakāreṇa anyatroktamapi darśayati--śeṣayostviti |
vīṇādinimitta[ka]tvamiti vārttikamayuktam | ta[8 kha]thā hi yadi vīṇādinimittatvam
apyavagataṃ tatkathaṃ tadanantaraṃ vīṇāśabdo veṇuśabda ityanumānataḥ pratipatsyata iti ?
satyam, asādhāraṇadharmābhiprāyamidaṃ tu yasmādasādhāraṇād dharmāt pratītāduttarakālaṃ
vīṇādinimitto'yaṃ śabda iti pratīyate, tadabhiprāyametad draṣṭavyam | bhāṣye yathokte
ityasti | tadudāharaṇaniṣṭhaṃ kṛtvā vyācaṣṭe--sahabhāvasyetyādi || 15 ||

ṭī || 1atha pramāṇaparīkṣetyādīti | atra ca parīkṣetyādītyādiśabdena
pramāṇaparīkṣāyā ādibhāṣyami[9 ka]tyuktam, na tu yathāśrutam, tadanantaraṃ bhāṣyābhāvāt |
sūtrasyaiva ca bhāvāditi | iha hi ṭīkākāraḥ saṃśayalakṣaṇe kramavyatikramasya kṛtatvād
idānīṃ cākramapakṣe'nādaraṃ matvā atha pramāṇaparīkṣeti bhāṣyasya saṃgatatvaṃ matvā
etad bhāṣyaṃ samarthayate--a[ā]rthena hīti | na parīkṣā saṃśayamantareṇeti | iyaṃ
hi ṭīkā pūraṇīyā | tathā hi na parīkṣā saṃśayamantareṇeti | saṃśayamāha--kiṃ
pramāṇāni santyuta na santīti, saṃśayaśca na bījamantareṇa, nirbījamāheti pūraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
tathāpītyādiṭīkā ca pūraṇīyaiva | tathā hi, tathāpi lokasiddhānyeva pramāṇāni santi,
tānyeva pramāṇāni | taireva pramāṇairityādi || 8 ||

2na pramāṇebhyaḥ prameya[9 kha]siddhiriti yathāśrutasūtrasya siddhiśabdo niścaya-
vacana ityarthe'nupapattiṃ paśyan samādhātumāha--3yadyapīti || 10 ||

4upalabdhihetoḥ ityādi siddhāntasyaiva 5cedasiddhārthatodbhāvanamarthaḥ, tathā sati
pūrvapakṣo durvāraḥ | tathā ca sādhu samarthitamityāśaṅkyāha--upalabdhihetorityādi ||
pratyakṣādīnāmabhāve kārakamiti | pratyakṣādīnāmabhāve sādhanīye kimidaṃ hetuvacanaṃ
kārakamityarthaḥ || 11 ||

6bādhitaviṣayatayā hetvābhāsa7 iti | kālātyayāpadiṣṭa ityarthaḥ | viruddhaṃ
cāheti virodhaṃ cāhetyarthaḥ | na tu yathāśrutam, viruddhatvasya sādhyaviparītavyāptyā
tatprasādhakarūpatvād iha ca tasyābhāvāditi pūrvasūtreṇa kālātyayāpadiṣṭa[10 ka]tvaviruddha-
[tva]yorvyaktamuktatvam, koṭidvayābhāvāt || 13 ||
sūtrānutthānaṃ manvānaḥ samarthayitumāha--8asyārtha iti || 14 ||

9pratiṣedhe'pi sāmyasyeti virodha ityarthaḥ | na tu yathāśrutam, matānujñāprasaṅgāditi |
tadutthānajñāpanārthamiti vārttikasya sūtrapāṭha ityadhyāhāro vyākhyānaṃ ṭīkākārasya |
bhāṣyakāropadarśitamākṣepamihāpi yojayati--atraiva ceti | asaṃbaddhamiti saṃbadva-
tvenānanubhūyamānamityarthaḥ | nanu ca kāryeṇaiva kāraṇānumānamidamapītyata āha--saṃyoginā
hīti | tathā satyetatpūrvabhāvī vahnirāsīdityevānumīyeta, na tvastīti bhāvaḥ || 15 ||

vā || 1yadāpyasterabhidhāyaka iti | nanu yadyayamasteḥ sa[10 kha]ttāyā evābhi-
dhāyakaḥ, tatkathamastiṃ vyanaktītyucyate ? na hi sattāvyañjakatvaṃ sattābhidhāyakatvamityekaḥ
ayamarthaḥ | satyam, asterabhidhāyaka iti sattāvyaktyabhidhāyaka iti kṛtvedaṃ vārttikaṃ
boddhavyam | gehasaṃbandhābhidhāyako bhavatyastiśabda iti | nanu nehāstiśabdasya nimittaṃ
paryālocyate, kiṃ tu tiṣṭhatiśabdasya | satyam, astiśabdo'stivācakaḥ śabda iti
boddhavyam ||

tadbhāvapratyayā iti | saiva cakṣurbhrāntiḥ saivapradīpakalikā jvalantī tiṣṭatīti
pratyayā ityarthaḥ | kāryamādhāravadityetat prasidhyatīti pratyakṣasiddham | tat kimiti
dṛṣṭānto mayā vācya ityarthaḥ | tadgatisthitivikārānuvidhānāditi | maṇau gacchati
tatprabhāpi gacchati, tasya [11 ka] sthitau cāvatiṣṭhate | tasya sphaṭikādimaṇerjapākusumādi-
sannidhau śvaityaviparītaṃ lauhityaṃ vikāra ityarthaḥ | tat prasiddhamiti pratyakṣasiddham | tat
kimiti dṛṣṭānto mayā vācya ityarthaḥ ||

nāpi kriyāṃ kevalāmiti | nanu na kriyā kevalā kvāpi pratīyate |
satyam, kuṭhāre yā kriyodyamananipātanarūpā sā laguḍe pratīyamānā na kārakamityevaṃparakam
etat | na tvanyathā kriyāyā vyabhicāraḥ śakyo darśayitum | kartṛvyapadeśa iti |
karteti vyapadeśamātraṃ na tu pāramārthikaṃ ka[11 kha]rtṛtvamityarthaḥ | kiñcit kathañcit
iti | etaccārādupakārakatvamapekṣya boddhavyam, kiṃñcit kathañcit kiñcit kathañciditi ||

na śakterityādivyapadeśa ityantasyoṭṭīkaṃ vyākhyānaṃ vyaktameva | ṭīkākṛnmate
tu avatiṣṭhata iti granthaḥ pacatyapākṣītpakṣyatītyanena saha vyastasaṃbandho yojayitavyaḥ |
paścāt 2śaktivyapekṣa iti vārttikaṃ yojanīyamiti || 16 ||

3prameyā ca ityādisūtraṃ prakṛtānanurūpaṃ manyamānaḥ pratyujjīvayati--yat punariti |
aniyatam aniyatasvabhāvam | āro[12 ka]pitaṃ sarpatvam, dhārātvamityapi pūraṇīyam |
atredamuttarasūtramiti, svīyaṃ ṭīkākārīyaṃ sūtrayojanam ||

prakṛtapūrvapakṣānācchādakaṃ bhāṣyamiti manyamāna āha--ayamabhisandhiriti |
anaikāntikatvaṃ hetorupapādayitumāha--kṣaṇabhaṅgeti | asya cārthasya ityādi ṭīkā |
vārttikakāraḥ sūtram itthaṃ yojitavāniti pratipādayitumiti dvedhā ṭīkākārīyaḥ

pāṭhaḥ | yathāprāmāṇya iti | paricchedye iti pūraṇīyam | punaśca prāmāṇye
ityasti | atrāpi paricchedye iti pūraṇīyam | tatprayoktṛtvasya kāraṇamiti | madhye
iti pūrayitvā bodhyavyam ||

kārakāntarāpekṣasyaiva hīti ṭīkā anupapannārthaiva | tathā hi prathamādhyāye
acetanasya [12 kha] tu bhāktaṃ kartṛtvaṃ na bhāvikamityuktavān svayameva ṭīkākāraḥ |
iha cācetanaṃ kartāramāha | tataścedamacetanam | acetanamapi karteva kartetyartho bodhyavyaḥ |
yadi 1yāvaduktaṃ bhavati na yātīti tāvaduktaṃ bhavati tiṣṭhatīti, tarhi gatiprati-
ṣedhasya kriyātvānupapattirityata āha--atra cetyādi | aupādhikaṃ kriyātvamityarthaḥ |
nanu svaviṣayajñānajanane cakṣurādyapekṣata eveti kathamanapekṣita ityata āha--vṛkṣasya
hīti | nanvevaṃ sati ghaṭasyācaitanyād gatividhārakaprayatnābhāvād ghaṭo gehe'stīti
prayogānupapatterityata āha--ghaṭo geha iti | nanu vṛkṣo na samudāyaḥ kiṃ tvavayavī,
tat kathaṃ samudāyasthaikadeśaṃ yokṣatītyata āha--avayavānāmiti | [13 ka] nanu
